world.title: 'Now boarding' … 240,000 miles from Earth, at the moon's first airport
world.description: The moon's getting its first airport, and it's about to get busy. Within the next two decades, NASA's planned Gateway—humanity's first lunar spaceport—may become a bustling hub for Orion crew capsules, lunar landers, cargo vehicles and astronauts traveling between Earth, the moon and, eventually, destinations in the deep unknown.

world.title: High folic acid in pregnancy linked to early bleeding risk
world.description: Women taking high-dose folic acid supplements during early pregnancy may face an increased risk of vaginal bleeding, according to new research from Flinders University and collaborating institutions that raises important questions about supplementation levels in countries with mandatory folic acid food fortification.
